population: preferred-cue test trials only; all labels = 1
aggregation: each trial-bin equally weighted; descriptive paired comparisons, not independent-bin tests

design.C_scoring: inner five-fold balanced accuracy; retain production objective
design.scaler: unweighted StandardScaler fitted separately within each training fold
design.weighted_classifier: all available trials; class_weight=balanced recalculated in every fitting fold
design.weighted_calibration: sigmoid on out-of-fold margins; inverse-class-frequency sample weights for equal cue prior
design.downsample: next sampling with each fit seed, then usual unweighted model/calibration
design.fold_groups: physical source trial IDs for both methods; differs from original cached row-position folds
design.null: 100 label permutations within the same observed training membership; C selection and calibration rerun
design.null_RNG: same across fit seeds; independent per time bin, inherited temporal-null limitation
design.nested_validation: 3 repeats of 5 outer folds on 143 training-pool trials; target136 excluded; full C/calibration fit inside outer training
design.fixed_features: 208 cached stationary cells; cell selection not nested
design.scope: focal trial fresh nulls; other session-trial caches used only for cluster-reference sensitivity

design.common_standardization: per-neuron mean/std over all 143 eligible training trials, excluding target; descriptive only
design.model_controls: C, model seed, labels, training row count and all calibration fold assignments fixed; full original scaling/calibration refitted for each hybrid
design.hybrids: synthetic training-feature interventions, not proposed biological trials or data cleaning
